recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of four men in 1980s fashion standing against a coastal sunset, characterized by high-contrast lighting, saturated warm tones, and a distinct halftone print texture typical of vintage vinyl sleeves.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background contrast via warm sunset backlighting against dark leather textures.
Horizontal alignment of subjects across the frame creating a balanced ensemble.
Text-to-image framing with titles anchored at the extreme top and bottom margins.
coreInvariants: Gradient sunset background transitioning from orange to purple.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects in a medium-full shot, positioned side-by-side, occupying the central 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central two figures, particularly the one in the striped shirt, acting as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the bold red title at the top, down through the faces of the band members, to the white subtitle at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily found in the sky above the heads and the beach at the feet.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones and sunset oranges in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns from the leather jackets.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary title and white for the secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background gradients contrasted with high-value highlights on the subjects' faces.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with minimal contrast.
Square-ish curves in rounded characters like 'O' and 'D'.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has a very shallow, wide curve.
The 'E' has equal length horizontal bars.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scale and tracking of the same extended sans-serif family.
graphicDevices: Color-blocked logo element in bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-set 80s tech aesthetic.
Provides the necessary squareness and wide stance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group portrait of four men with 1980s hairstyles and leather jackets standing on a beach at sunset. Apply a vintage CMYK halftone print texture and high-contrast warm lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in bright red ultra-extended sans-serif at the top. Add the secondary title in white wide-tracked extended sans-serif at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the top text horizontally stretched?
Is the bottom text widely letter-spaced?
Does the image have a visible dot-gain or halftone texture?
Are the hairstyles period-accurate to the mid-80s?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'floating' text appearance over the image.
Ensure the red title is the most saturated element.
Verify the four-person horizontal composition is maintained.
Confirm the halftone texture doesn't obscure facial features.
